cz: O téhle řasence se říká, že zdvojnásobí délku řas.

mistakes.text: People say this mascara doubles the length of your lashes.
mistakes.normalized: people say this mascara doubles the length of your lashes
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvičuje sa Passive: „This mascara is said to double…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se Passive: „This mascara is said to double…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: “This mascara is said to double…”.

mistakes.text: This mascara is said that it doubles the length of your lashes.
mistakes.normalized: this mascara is said that it doubles the length of your lashes
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po podmete s „is said“ nasleduje Infinitive, nie „that“: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po podmětu s „is said“ následuje Infinitive, ne „that“: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When the subject comes first, “is said” takes an Infinitive, not “that”: “is said to double”.

mistakes.text: This mascara is said doubling the length of your lashes.
mistakes.normalized: this mascara is said doubling the length of your lashes
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „is said“ patrí Infinitive: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „is said“ patří Infinitive: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “is said” use the Infinitive: “is said to double”.

mistakes.text: This mascara says to double the length of your lashes.
mistakes.normalized: this mascara says to double the length of your lashes
mistakes.feedback_sk: Riasenka nič nehovorí; treba Passive: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Řasenka nic neříká; je potřeba Passive: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The mascara doesn't say anything; you need the Passive: “is said to double”.

mistakes.text: About this mascara is said that it doubles the length of your lashes.
mistakes.normalized: about this mascara is said that it doubles the length of your lashes
mistakes.feedback_sk: Slovenské „o … sa hovorí“ sa neprekladá doslova: „This mascara is said to…“ alebo „It is said that…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: České „o … se říká“ se nepřekládá doslova: „This mascara is said to…“ nebo „It is said that…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't translate word for word: say “This mascara is said to…” or “It is said that…”.

mistakes.text: This mascara is supposed to double the length of your lashes.
mistakes.normalized: this mascara is supposed to double the length of your lashes
mistakes.kind: supposed to instead of is said
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvičuje sa Passive so slovesom „say“: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se Passive se slovesem „say“: „is said to double“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive with “say”: “is said to double”.
